# KeyMods

The modifier keys held with a key press.

`cmd` is the Command key on macOS and is never set on Windows or Linux,
where application shortcuts are built on `ctrl` instead.

## Parameters

- `shift`: A boolean. Shift was held. Defaults to `false`.
- `ctrl`: A boolean. Control was held. Defaults to `false`.
- `alt`: A boolean. Alt (Option on macOS) was held. Defaults to `false`.
- `cmd`: A boolean. Command (macOS only) was held. Defaults to `false`.
